record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: Does there exist a universal exponent d>3 such that, for every polygon, the full billiard complexity has a cubic lower bound and an upper bound of order n^d?

evidence.quote: Гипотеза 1. Существует d > 3, такое, что полная сложность биллиарда для любого многоугольника имеет кубическую нижнюю оценку и верхнюю оценку степени d.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let P be a simple polygon in the Euclidean plane, and consider the billiard flow on P (a point particle moving in straight lines inside P, reflecting elastically on the boundary, with trajectories hitting vertices left undefined). Code each billiard trajectory by the cyclic sequence of boundary sides it hits, and let f_P(n) denote the full billiard complexity of P, namely the number of distinct words of length n that occur as factors of some billiard trajectory's coding.

Question: Does there exist a universal real exponent d > 3 such that for every polygon P there are constants c_1(P), c_2(P) > 0 with
   c_1(P) · n^3  ≤  f_P(n)  ≤  c_2(P) · n^d
for all sufficiently large n? Equivalently, is the full billiard complexity of every polygon bounded below by a cubic function and above by a polynomial of degree at most some universal d > 3?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., Krueger–Nogueira–Troubetzkoy, 2023, arXiv:2312.04133) establishes cubic growth of billiard complexity for typical/generic polygons and along certain subsequences, and precise cubic asymptotics have been obtained for regular N-gons. However, no result establishes a universal polynomial upper bound of degree d > 3 valid for every polygon together with a cubic lower bound for every polygon. The conjecture appears to remain open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: On the complexity of polygonal billiards (arXiv:2312.04133)
status_evidence.snippet: We show that the complexity of the billiard in a typical polygon grows cubically...
status_evidence.claim: Cubic growth established for typical (not all) polygons; no universal polynomial upper bound shown.

status_evidence.title: Complexity for billiards in regular N-gons
status_evidence.snippet: Precise cubic asymptotics for the complexity of the billiard language in regular N-gons.
status_evidence.claim: Specific class (regular N-gons) resolved with cubic asymptotics, not the universal conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Complexity and growth for polygonal billiards (Cassaigne–Hubert–Troubetzkoy)
status_evidence.snippet: Complexity and growth for polygonal billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier foundational work on complexity bounds; full universal polynomial bound remained open.
